states.new: No requirement is currently pending: no client is waiting for an order to be taken, no taken order is waiting for food, no prepared food is waiting to be served, and no fallen food is waiting to be picked up. This is the clean resting state, so if the episode ended now nothing would be left unmet. The shop routine continues, and later arrivals, orders, preparations, servings or slips will create new obligations.
states.old: Nothing is pending: no client has been left waiting for attention, no prepared food has been promised to a client, and no fallen food is awaiting pickup. From here the work is to respond to whatever comes next: a newly arrived client must have their order taken, fetched food must eventually be prepared and served, and any fallen food must be picked up on the very next step.

states.new: A client's order has been taken, but no food has been prepared for it yet. Fetch a portion from the pantry and prepare it at the stove, then hand the prepared food to the waiting client. Handling this returns you to a clean state with nothing outstanding.
states.old: An order has been taken, so that client is waiting and the taken order must still be followed by preparing food at the stove and then serving it. The order of fetching and preparing remains to be done. If food slips during this work, it must be picked up on the immediately following step.

states.new: Food has been prepared for the waiting client and is ready to be handed over. Serve it at the counter to clear the outstanding promise. After serving, the shop returns to a clean state until the next arrival, order or slip.
states.old: The carried food has been prepared at the stove, so it must still be delivered to the waiting client. Because a client's order was necessarily taken before preparation, that client is still owed a serve. Any slip during this errand must be recovered on the very next step.

states.new: The carried food has just slipped out of your hands, so you are not holding it. You must be holding food again on the very next step—pick up the fallen portion immediately. If the next step passes without food in hand, the recovery requirement is broken for good and the task fails.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while an order was already taken, so the client's order still needs preparing and serving. Picking the fallen food back up on the very next step is required, and failing to do so ends the task in failure.

states.new: An order has been taken, and the food has just slipped from your hands before any food was prepared for that order. You must pick up food on the very next step or the recovery requirement is broken and the task fails. Once food is back in hand, it still needs to be prepared at the stove and then served to the waiting client.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands and an order is outstanding, so the client still needs preparation and serving of food. The slip must be answered by picking the food back up on the very next step; leaving the hands empty then makes success impossible.

states.new: Prepared food has slipped out of your hands while the client's order remains unserved. Pick it up on the very next step; missing that step breaks the immediate-recovery requirement and fails the task. Once recovered, the prepared food still must be handed to the waiting client.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while food was already prepared, so the prepared portion must be regained and delivered to the client. The fallen food must be picked up on the immediately next step, or the task fails for good.

states.new: A client has arrived and is waiting, but their order has not been taken yet. Take the order at the counter, then fetch and prepare food and serve it. The order need not be taken on the very next step, but it must eventually be taken and the whole request completed.
states.old: A client has just arrived and their order has not been taken yet. The immediate job is to take that order, after which food must be fetched, prepared at the stove and served; any slip along the way must be recovered on the very next step.

states.new: Two jobs are outstanding: a waiting client's order still needs to be taken, and some prepared food still needs to be served. Take the order and serve the prepared food. Further preparation for the new order will follow once those are handled.
states.old: A client has just arrived and still needs to place an order, and separately a prepared portion is being carried that must be delivered to a waiting client. Both the new client's order and the pending serve remain outstanding, and any slip of the carried food must be recovered on the very next step.

states.new: A client has arrived and is waiting for their order, and the food has just slipped from your hands. You must be holding food again on the very next step or the recovery requirement is broken and the task fails. After that immediate recovery, the waiting client's order still needs to be taken and the rest of the request completed.
states.old: A client has just arrived and the food has just slipped out of the hands, with an order already taken by that client. The food must be picked up on the immediately next step, then prepared and served to the waiting client.

states.new: Three jobs are outstanding: a waiting client's order still needs to be taken, prepared food still needs to be served, and the food has just fallen. Recover the fallen food on the very next step or the task fails immediately. After recovering it, take the pending order and serve the prepared food.
states.old: A client has just arrived and the food has just slipped out of the hands, while food had already been prepared for a waiting client. The fallen food must be retrieved on the very next step, then delivered; both the new client's order and the pending serve remain.

states.new: Two jobs are outstanding: a client's order still needs to be taken, and food still needs to be prepared for an order that was already taken. Take the waiting order and prepare the owed food. Completing them returns the shop toward a clean state, ready for the next customer.
states.old: A new client has arrived and still needs to have their order taken, while an earlier order already has food prepared and awaiting delivery. The new order must be taken and the prepared portion served, with any slip recovered on the next step.

states.new: Three jobs are outstanding: a client's order still needs to be taken, food still needs preparing for an earlier taken order, and the food has just fallen. You must pick up food on the very next step or the recovery requirement is broken and the task fails. Once recovered, take the waiting order and prepare the food that is owed.
states.old: A new client has arrived and needs their order taken, and the food has just slipped from the hands while a previous order is outstanding. The fallen food must be picked up on the very next step, then prepared and served alongside handling the new client.

states.new: Two jobs are outstanding: food still needs to be prepared for an order that was already taken, and prepared food is waiting to be served. Prepare the owed food at the stove and hand the prepared portion to the client. No fallen food is currently awaiting recovery.
states.old: A prepared portion is being carried and must be delivered to the waiting client. Any slip of it must be answered by picking it up on the immediately next step; if it cannot be recovered then, the task can no longer succeed.

states.new: Three jobs are outstanding: food still needs to be prepared for a taken order, prepared food still needs to be served, and the food has just fallen. The fallen food must be back in your hands on the very next step, or the recovery requirement is broken and the task fails. After recovering it, prepare the owed food and serve the prepared portion.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while a prepared portion was still owed to a waiting client, and no order is currently taken. The food must be picked up on the very next step, then served; failing to regain it immediately makes success impossible.

states.new: A food slip was not followed by holding food on the very next step. That immediate-recovery requirement is mandatory and irreversible, so the task has failed and successful completion is no longer possible. Later actions cannot make up for the missed pickup.
states.old: A mandatory requirement has been broken: food that slipped was not picked up on the very next step, or carried food was lost without being regained immediately. Successful completion is no longer possible.

states.new: Three jobs are outstanding: a client's order still needs to be taken, food still needs preparing for an order already taken, and prepared food still needs to be served. Take the order, prepare the owed food, and hand over the prepared portion. No fallen food is currently awaiting recovery.
states.old: A client has just arrived and their order must be taken next, and there is also a prepared portion still to be delivered to a waiting client. If the carried food slips, it must be picked up on the immediately following step, or the task fails.

states.new: Four jobs are outstanding: a client's order still needs to be taken, food still needs preparing for a taken order, prepared food still needs serving, and the food has just fallen. Recover the fallen food on the very next step or the task fails immediately. Then take the waiting order, prepare the owed food and serve the prepared portion.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while both a new client's order and a pending prepared serve are outstanding. The fallen food must be picked up on the very next step; otherwise success becomes impossible.
